paragraphs: In Rosh Hashanah 31a he reported in the name of Rav; Hyman says that the name there should be Rav Chanan bar Rava.[^1]

notes.text: לא. gives Rosh Hashanah 31a under the period convention, without independent named-edition verification. Hyman proposes changing the name there from Anan to Chanan, while retaining the earlier in-the-name-of-Rav attribution. The older rendering that makes Rav Chanan the authority in that attribution is not adopted. Anan and Chanan stay distinct, and the correction remains Hyman’s instruction rather than a newly verified variant. All separate Rav titles are full.
